package fixture

type Admission struct {
	// Identity belongs to the request.
	ID, ScopeKind, ScopeID, Key, Hash, Status string
	Request, Body []byte `json:"payload"` // Encoded bytes.
	First /* before comma , */, /* after comma */ Second *int
	Left,
	// Right is documented separately.
	Right map[string][]byte
	One, Two struct { X, Y int }
	*Embedded
}

type Embedded struct{}

func grouped(a, b int) (x, y int) { return a, b }
